subject: API change calendar + partner testing/gating for Adlib integration
messages:
From: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@cloudforge.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Request: API version sunset schedule + integration test window

Hi Soojin,

Quick note from the Adlib side — we’ve been tracking Redwood’s planned removal of the v1 embeddings endpoint and the change to the streaming payload schema you mentioned at last partner summit. Our integration (CloudForge connector) relies on both behaviors and we’ll need a coordinated timeline and a small mutually-agreed testing window so our customers don’t face regressions.

Attached: adlib-impact-summary.pdf (short impact analysis).

Can we get a 2-week test window in Feb and a freeze notice 3 weeks prior so we can ship a minor SDK release? Also need to confirm backward-compatible fallbacks during the handover.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync.

—Rachel
Rachel Stone
Head of Integrations, CloudForge (on behalf of Adlib Solutions)
partners@adlib.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@cloudforge.io>, Adlib Solutions <partners@adlib.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: API version sunset schedule + integration test window

Thanks for the heads-up, Rachel — and thanks for the impact summary.

We can definitely coordinate. High-level plan I propose:
- Redwood publishes formal deprecation notice for v1 streaming + old embedding endpoint on 2027-01-29.
- Two-week partner test window: 2027-02-14 -> 2027-02-28 (can be shifted by a week if needed).
- Code freeze notice to partners published 3 weeks before the test window (2027-01-24).

Marcus and Vanessa — can you confirm feasibility for the test environment availability and whether we can provide a temporary compatibility shim for customers who can’t update immediately?

Rachel — can you confirm the list of CloudForge customers you’ll want in the pilot and whether Adlib can provide a test harness? I’ll loop Grace from CS to coordinate monitoring and rollback SLOs.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@cloudforge.io>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 15:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: API version sunset schedule + integration test window

On Tue, Jan 12, 2027 at 10:02 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marcus and Vanessa — can you confirm feasibility for the test environment availability and whether we can provide a temporary compatibility shim for customers who can’t update immediately?

We can stand up a partner test cluster for the two-week window. A few technical notes / asks:
- We will provide a compatibility shim that translates v1 streaming semantics to the new streaming schema, but it’s limited to 5k concurrent sessions. If Adlib expects more, we’ll need to schedule additional capacity.
- Please ask Adlib to run the compat-matrix-v2.xlsx test matrix (I attached the current workbook to this mail) against their SDKs — it enumerates the edge cases we’ve seen.
- We’ll expose a dedicated endpoint (partners.redwood.com/v1-compat) and a short TTL cache to mirror production behavior.

I’ve attached: compat-matrix-v2.xlsx (workbook with test cases).

If the partners want a longer window or earlier access to the shim, we can negotiate via the Dedicated capacity team (costs may apply).

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Product Manager, Runtime Integrations — Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@cloudforge.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: API version sunset schedule + integration test window

Hi all — operational confirmation from my side:
- Proposed maintenance window for the public endpoint change is 2027-03-01 00:00 - 03:00 PT. During that time we switch routing and promote the new streaming schema to prod (we’ll keep the shim active on partners endpoint for the test cohort).
- Suggest running smoke tests on 2027-02-14 (first day of the test window) and again 2027-02-21. Those are 2-hour windows where partner traffic is routed to staging.
- If Adlib wants a signed SLA exception for the shim period, we’ll need a DocuSign acknowledgement (I can circulate a short amendment).

Soojin — I’ll add the maintenance bulletin to the calendar once you confirm. Rachel — please send the list of pilot customers and the test harness artifacts (CSV or automated scripts).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Reliability — Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@cloudforge.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: API version sunset schedule + integration test window

Thanks — this looks good and aligns with what Adlib needs. Confirming:
- Pilot customers: Acme Media, Brightline Health, and ClearSight (I’ll provide contact emails this afternoon).
- Test harness: attaching adlib-test-plan.csv with expected request/response pairs and failure tolerance.
- Agree to the two-week test window 2027-02-14 -> 2027-02-28 and the maintenance window on 2027-03-01.
- We would like the DocuSign SLA amendment for the compatibility shim; please send the link.

Appreciate the quick alignment — we’ll start internal QA on Monday and ping the list with any blockers.

Best,
Rachel
Head of Integrations, CloudForge (on behalf of Adlib Solutions)

Attachments: adlib-test-plan.csv (text/csv)
